Herbal liver supplements—such as `milk thistle and turmeric` —are widely used for general liver support, though clinical evidence is mixed and some herbs carry serious liver toxicity risks. Lifestyle habits remain the primary foundation for liver health, and supplements do not cure liver conditions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXaP4RTD6gV38Pcdaj_xqNNrA6F5nTi-KER6mCCIM-r8CwfHmq7vggT1yxCm7ylpXiGP2Xh8dF8fsvIvjRhw2HPqv9R_IVtFz7FO3uFFUQQJdXb1v79TWSs_9GLC065rSxOPTqhVTVl9DA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0gEBxCJF11Vl9gHTBjNET8o7kb1jEVVNt-G8v5xFlcMe973WNDr7dF7-q81H8K3glQlcyX6RFvNTjbK3Ke2ri5jgpZNRQxYsHb4kXgk7ecBngiBM_WCy6-sm9HxEWVqE__Ytf_4UUrcfn-yEGv6G00R8_tHAToPlozjG2vX49R-1CA2H3QRO3AUL8y4mwzBm-db16OquZqiqS9asbj_JHKjb22K0IqiBhPgcEV2rPtnlfemJ7-z4w--jyV3qP2SSM_46W7QKvfVmYIX1ZyeiH94vq1E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)

### Commonly Studied Herbs

- **Milk thistle (silymarin):** Studied for supporting liver enzymes and reducing oxidative stress in fatty or alcohol-related liver conditions, though results vary across trials.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXaP4RTD6gV38Pcdaj_xqNNrA6F5nTi-KER6mCCIM-r8CwfHmq7vggT1yxCm7ylpXiGP2Xh8dF8fsvIvjRhw2HPqv9R_IVtFz7FO3uFFUQQJdXb1v79TWSs_9GLC065rSxOPTqhVTVl9DA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7ld4Kg-zcEypT-xyVOLb5jX63Ukx0yFvH69EcVRs4nTC5fSqvem705lsHyn6EMkdy0Sx5l5Wtd_6s11xYoMK7cyW0MsJkXOopQ3HEvYxqhN6IzGtUjUEMhADnjTVQVRIvb72iSaRGeywCOEIlF5Pp3bf_E2UjCw)
- **Turmeric (curcumin):** Research explores its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects on liver fat and scarring, though high doses can pose risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0gEBxCJF11Vl9gHTBjNET8o7kb1jEVVNt-G8v5xFlcMe973WNDr7dF7-q81H8K3glQlcyX6RFvNTjbK3Ke2ri5jgpZNRQxYsHb4kXgk7ecBngiBM_WCy6-sm9HxEWVqE__Ytf_4UUrcfn-yEGv6G00R8_tHAToPlozjG2vX49R-1CA2H3QRO3AUL8y4mwzBm-db16OquZqiqS9asbj_JHKjb22K0IqiBhPgcEV2rPtnlfemJ7-z4w--jyV3qP2SSM_46W7QKvfVmYIX1ZyeiH94vq1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7ld4Kg-zcEypT-xyVOLb5jX63Ukx0yFvH69EcVRs4nTC5fSqvem705lsHyn6EMkdy0Sx5l5Wtd_6s11xYoMK7cyW0MsJkXOopQ3HEvYxqhN6IzGtUjUEMhADnjTVQVRIvb72iSaRGeywCOEIlF5Pp3bf_E2UjCw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF11CUPj433533aiCJ36BzBboju_1WziCaL04p5dvzQ9Z2YtKXBQ4yiYlqqiG_ArX-UsnCwOwBWDw0WlJ8sib3Ax8kUJRVZqCVfYEth3qiRHjbbdc5-wCMZirQdGO1N_HTYasPAw_kmrkkyYBCGtjZwNVjA6dbwLcyAoZ-oyw8D24lZu_ng0robFfkA1-lEkjqvF3DMmBYtCBBS2m4Unpaum686drBQTo3Q9wkNO_B)
- **Ginger, ginseng, and green tea:** Frequently marketed for liver support or metabolic health, with mixed evidence and potential drug interactions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF15efMbLF3rzW8tL6XGSVosIgbIc90R7r32wsxFvl5PatzhmHXmjdZYo_KWONPz8GbwmyU54hOOYont_fvWncCjI41PVDsoe3E1fwsUIe6Z_wZ_M1MtyvhO5Ll5Lwm-SVq1ujqn4wTxq1sTuKmL7lL4hAzITzguYoqSCSX_ntV0qomyIknk0K2S5ftwpJLx5-siNREbE)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXaP4RTD6gV38Pcdaj_xqNNrA6F5nTi-KER6mCCIM-r8CwfHmq7vggT1yxCm7ylpXiGP2Xh8dF8fsvIvjRhw2HPqv9R_IVtFz7FO3uFFUQQJdXb1v79TWSs_9GLC065rSxOPTqhVTVl9DA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)

For a broad breakdown of clinical findings on plant compounds, see this [Evidence-based herbal treatments in liver diseases](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXaP4RTD6gV38Pcdaj_xqNNrA6F5nTi-KER6mCCIM-r8CwfHmq7vggT1yxCm7ylpXiGP2Xh8dF8fsvIvjRhw2HPqv9R_IVtFz7FO3uFFUQQJdXb1v79TWSs_9GLC065rSxOPTqhVTVl9DA) review.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXaP4RTD6gV38Pcdaj_xqNNrA6F5nTi-KER6mCCIM-r8CwfHmq7vggT1yxCm7ylpXiGP2Xh8dF8fsvIvjRhw2HPqv9R_IVtFz7FO3uFFUQQJdXb1v79TWSs_9GLC065rSxOPTqhVTVl9DA)

### Safety and Liver Injury Risks
"Natural" does not guarantee safety. Herbal supplements are not approved by the FDA for safety or effectiveness before reaching the market, and products can contain undisclosed ingredients or contaminants.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF11CUPj433533aiCJ36BzBboju_1WziCaL04p5dvzQ9Z2YtKXBQ4yiYlqqiG_ArX-UsnCwOwBWDw0WlJ8sib3Ax8kUJRVZqCVfYEth3qiRHjbbdc5-wCMZirQdGO1N_HTYasPAw_kmrkkyYBCGtjZwNVjA6dbwLcyAoZ-oyw8D24lZu_ng0robFfkA1-lEkjqvF3DMmBYtCBBS2m4Unpaum686drBQTo3Q9wkNO_B)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF15efMbLF3rzW8tL6XGSVosIgbIc90R7r32wsxFvl5PatzhmHXmjdZYo_KWONPz8GbwmyU54hOOYont_fvWncCjI41PVDsoe3E1fwsUIe6Z_wZ_M1MtyvhO5Ll5Lwm-SVq1ujqn4wTxq1sTuKmL7lL4hAzITzguYoqSCSX_ntV0qomyIknk0K2S5ftwpJLx5-siNREbE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)

- **Herb-induced liver injury:** Concentrated extracts—including green tea extract, ashwagandha, black cohosh, Garcinia cambogia, red yeast rice, and high-dose turmeric—have been linked to liver injury in some people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXesxArnihpryRcso-YrAnxEYFd6WjZ9gQ5DCtuu-3lw5MfMl06ZiAs5wZUl4_MUYZxBCr9jfKQLripDsiEGtPW2cVtaCEotjEuceFy7uwMR9tvFkOYyv1cnBU1vd7FuCA-N5qXQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7ld4Kg-zcEypT-xyVOLb5jX63Ukx0yFvH69EcVRs4nTC5fSqvem705lsHyn6EMkdy0Sx5l5Wtd_6s11xYoMK7cyW0MsJkXOopQ3HEvYxqhN6IzGtUjUEMhADnjTVQVRIvb72iSaRGeywCOEIlF5Pp3bf_E2UjCw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF11CUPj433533aiCJ36BzBboju_1WziCaL04p5dvzQ9Z2YtKXBQ4yiYlqqiG_ArX-UsnCwOwBWDw0WlJ8sib3Ax8kUJRVZqCVfYEth3qiRHjbbdc5-wCMZirQdGO1N_HTYasPAw_kmrkkyYBCGtjZwNVjA6dbwLcyAoZ-oyw8D24lZu_ng0robFfkA1-lEkjqvF3DMmBYtCBBS2m4Unpaum686drBQTo3Q9wkNO_B)
- **Medication interactions:** Herbs can alter how medications are processed or increase bleeding and liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX7ld4Kg-zcEypT-xyVOLb5jX63Ukx0yFvH69EcVRs4nTC5fSqvem705lsHyn6EMkdy0Sx5l5Wtd_6s11xYoMK7cyW0MsJkXOopQ3HEvYxqhN6IzGtUjUEMhADnjTVQVRIvb72iSaRGeywCOEIlF5Pp3bf_E2UjCw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)
- **Warning signs:** Seek prompt medical care if you notice dark urine, yellowing skin or eyes, persistent nausea, abdominal pain, or unusual fatigue while taking supplements.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF11CUPj433533aiCJ36BzBboju_1WziCaL04p5dvzQ9Z2YtKXBQ4yiYlqqiG_ArX-UsnCwOwBWDw0WlJ8sib3Ax8kUJRVZqCVfYEth3qiRHjbbdc5-wCMZirQdGO1N_HTYasPAw_kmrkkyYBCGtjZwNVjA6dbwLcyAoZ-oyw8D24lZu_ng0robFfkA1-lEkjqvF3DMmBYtCBBS2m4Unpaum686drBQTo3Q9wkNO_B)

You can check documented case reports and safety profiles in [LiverTox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXesxArnihpryRcso-YrAnxEYFd6WjZ9gQ5DCtuu-3lw5MfMl06ZiAs5wZUl4_MUYZxBCr9jfKQLripDsiEGtPW2cVtaCEotjEuceFy7uwMR9tvFkOYyv1cnBU1vd7FuCA-N5qXQ) or read practical safety guidance from [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXesxArnihpryRcso-YrAnxEYFd6WjZ9gQ5DCtuu-3lw5MfMl06ZiAs5wZUl4_MUYZxBCr9jfKQLripDsiEGtPW2cVtaCEotjEuceFy7uwMR9tvFkOYyv1cnBU1vd7FuCA-N5qXQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)

### Shopping and Selection Tips
If you and a doctor decide to try a supplement, look for third-party testing (such as USP or NSF) to reduce quality and labeling risks. You can browse options at [Gaia Herbs](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXBPw22uDgWClIAanRk8wJHvaPtd0qXikzJGPkTEh3lbV9R0MukjbJtyFr83oewFwsbeQSAehjHxinLAadlB4vSP-fMX0Rbfci-lEC2QM-60s3cB137L1z7r6E4EDTgAXUdadJ6J2N9TqeirFmERg) or [Amazon](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXB-j_AXJMWPcRdPWlkDAU6VyFHwhhlnOS5OoWb7BDgf9ON4Opz36w7w99krKwBUjp_n9YXHaPhCkPDJnSLorADfDUZu9zhfQNDAENai-FGmjNXUAmttx9UhLj0w4) , and always review ingredient labels with a healthcare provider first.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYQHEIkXXB-j_AXJMWPcRdPWlkDAU6VyFHwhhlnOS5OoWb7BDgf9ON4Opz36w7w99krKwBUjp_n9YXHaPhCkPDJnSLorADfDUZu9zhfQNDAENai-FGmjNXUAmttx9UhLj0w4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsgEBxCJF11CUPj433533aiCJ36BzBboju_1WziCaL04p5dvzQ9Z2YtKXBQ4yiYlqqiG_ArX-UsnCwOwBWDw0WlJ8sib3Ax8kUJRVZqCVfYEth3qiRHjbbdc5-wCMZirQdGO1N_HTYasPAw_kmrkkyYBCGtjZwNVjA6dbwLcyAoZ-oyw8D24lZu_ng0robFfkA1-lEkjqvF3DMmBYtCBBS2m4Unpaum686drBQTo3Q9wkNO_B)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF15MxTNJx1WE2buuKJG6wqxsMtN2dBQTRWX2IRu1qduvS-S0P1oEGgrLFvDYnY4zzHCPXRNdOactl0rBf9Te72fDnVmnlzUh3D0RUZoMyLEkbbx3OGEPvlExmExfkte5_NptBZY9oUS547YG0DXi9Xb8DUthn--B-sfsnMKc)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXBPw22uDgWClIAanRk8wJHvaPtd0qXikzJGPkTEh3lbV9R0MukjbJtyFr83oewFwsbeQSAehjHxinLAadlB4vSP-fMX0Rbfci-lEC2QM-60s3cB137L1z7r6E4EDTgAXUdadJ6J2N9TqeirFmERg)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAES0gEBxCJF11Vl9gHTBjNET8o7kb1jEVVNt-G8v5xFlcMe973WNDr7dF7-q81H8K3glQlcyX6RFvNTjbK3Ke2ri5jgpZNRQxYsHb4kXgk7ecBngiBM_WCy6-sm9HxEWVqE__Ytf_4UUrcfn-yEGv6G00R8_tHAToPlozjG2vX49R-1CA2H3QRO3AUL8y4mwzBm-db16OquZqiqS9asbj_JHKjb22K0IqiBhPgcEV2rPtnlfemJ7-z4w--jyV3qP2SSM_46W7QKvfVmYIX1ZyeiH94vq1E)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScAHEIkXXgr0-kq4M74AlYyaXtTsXrzm2vKSX_3W4fQaMjiaOUqqO8F6FeyIGP7QTF1GSpj0LWCMT4HNgAoBPad2Ba9UZ3Efk5vDlhIhVXn7HBRRtxCEcVXsj9dUN-LQjn-77zU8bP8MxTVzT0IrA88c)If you are considering a specific product, share:

- **Your goal** (general wellness, fatty liver support, or an existing condition)
- **Current medications** or health conditions to check for interactions

items.text: Herb-induced liver injury: Concentrated extracts—including green tea extract, ashwagandha, black cohosh, Garcinia cambogia, red yeast rice, and high-dose turmeric—have been linked to liver injury in some people. Medication interactions: Herbs can alter how medications are processed or increase bleeding and liver strain. Warning signs: Seek prompt medical care if you notice dark urine, yellowing skin or eyes, persistent nausea, abdominal pain, or unusual fatigue while taking supplements.
